name: Spectra
_turns: How many turns a game lasts (the arena doc); the turn track at the table's end has a slot for each.
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From a photo of the user's drawn board (mapstomake/spectra.webp, perspective-straightened; the white blobs on it are painted-over statues, left out): a graveyard of open ground with four crypts two levels tall, lanterns on two crypt corners, 14 statues that move on the dice, 4 flags.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. solid = nothing can stand on or cross it (no snap point). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). L = a crypt corner with a lantern (painted icon). S = a statue's starting tile (a loose stone pawn players move).
_coords: Edge numbers as on the user's board: 1-8 twice along each edge (two d8 runs: columns from player 1's left, rows from player 1's side), inside the edge tiles, each facing out from its edge. sides: the d4 direction of each edge (player 1's edge, right, player 2's edge, left), a badge on that edge.
_marker_style: plain: the spawns are painted as a translucent white S with the player's number as a subscript (Avia's, the user's choice for every map), facing their own player.
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: graveyard grass, crypt roof slabs, crypt walls.
